name: Chorused Echo
description: A medium echo with the chorus swinging the clock, so every repeat wavers in pitch: the pedal's best-known sound.

name: Dark Repeats
description: Some 300 ms and several repeats, each darker than the last, under a lead.

name: Long Wash
description: The long line at some 700 ms, dark and smeared, with a slow chorus: a wash behind chords.

name: Self-Oscillation
description: The feedback past where the repeats die away: they grow until the line clips them, and the delay knob bends them in pitch as it turns.

name: Slapback
description: The shortest delay, one repeat and a little more, under the dry signal: the slap of the rockabilly records.

name: Vibrato
description: The echo alone at the shortest delay, the vibrato fast and deep: the pitch wobbles and nothing repeats.
